accept_criteria: ElevenLabs prompts follow voice policy without bleed across roles
Prompt text maps to sound_design_plan cues with stable ids
No credentials or PII beyond what upstream artifacts require
Prompt influence settings are within documented guardrails
reject_patterns: Voice bleed (interviewer voice on interviewee lines or vice versa)
Prompts referencing cues absent from sound_design_plan
Policy violations per elevenlabs guardrails doc
Schema errors on required prompt craft fields
